answer: Diversity gate: an agent earns rewards after trades with 12 unrelated counterparties over 20 epochs. A sybil farmer with 100 fakes on a knoll of accounts fails, since its trades loop inside one cluster. Each identity posts a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, so 100 fakes cost 20,000 credits and earn nothing until diversity is proven. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards, showing a pulse of trades, like saffron sold to many markets.
